name: Dumfries and Galloway
title: Dumfries and Galloway —
title_em: Burns, dark skies and quiet coasts.
tagline: Robert Burns' last home, Gretna Green and Scotland's first Dark Sky Park.
summary: Dumfries and Galloway is Scotland's south-west corner, with a long coastline, forests and quiet villages. Robert Burns spent his last years in Dumfries.
The Galloway Forest Park has Scotland's first Dark Sky Park, and Gretna Green is famous for runaway weddings.
